_doc: Named parameter sets for sim_watchdog.py; `sim_watchdog.py params --profile NAME` lists the effect of each. Override single values with --set key=value.

ffn_prefill._doc: 128-token FFN prefill on the 16c4m platform: host init takes a few ms of simulated time, the window 0.6 to 1.3 ms, and no task runs longer than a few tens of us.

moe_prefill._doc: 256-token MoE prefill on the 16c4m platform (array shape 3): host init a few ms of simulated time, the window up to 1.5 ms at full size; the route's top-6 is one long task on the root.
